maxCaptureLevel.title: Highest capture level
maxCaptureLevel.description: The most data Steplight may keep: minimal (URLs without query strings, step kinds and flags), standard (plus redacted page text and request metadata) or full (plus redacted request body previews). Users can choose a lower level but never a higher one.

forceRedactionPatterns.title: Always-applied redaction patterns
forceRedactionPatterns.description: Regular expressions whose matches are always replaced by [REDACTED:custom], in addition to the built-in patterns and the user's own. Patterns that could cause catastrophic backtracking are ignored.

siteAllowlist.title: Only record these sites
siteAllowlist.description: When not empty, Steplight records only these domains (example.com also covers its subdomains; *.example.com is accepted). The user's own allow list is ignored.

siteDenylist.title: Never record these sites
siteDenylist.description: Domains that are never recorded. Added to the user's own deny list; users cannot remove these entries.

retentionDays.title: Maximum retention (days)
retentionDays.description: Stored runs are deleted after at most this many days. Users can choose a shorter period.

disableExport.title: Disable export and import
disableExport.description: Hides the ability to export runs and reports and to import run files.

disableCliConnection.title: Disable the local CLI connection
disableCliConnection.description: The extension never sends data to a local Steplight CLI server and cannot be paired with one; runs stay inside the extension.

disableDeepCapture.title: Disable Deep capture
disableDeepCapture.description: Prevents users from turning on the page-level hooks for fetch, XMLHttpRequest, sendBeacon and WebSocket.

requireEncryption.title: Require encryption
requireEncryption.description: Exports must be password-protected. (Runs stored inside the extension are always encrypted.)
